notes.title: Demo Page Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're excited to announce that the standalone store page and review function for the Ringash demo officially opened on July 3rd!

If you've tried the demo before—or if you're just now discovering it—we'd love to hear your thoughts! Feel free to leave a review, share feedback, or let us know what you liked (or didn't like). Every comment helps us improve the game and build something even better.

Thank you all for your support!
